faq.q: What is the origin of Jamaal?
faq.a: Jamaal is associated with Arabic. Jamaal is Arabic جَمَال (Jamāl) 'beauty, comeliness, grace', from the root ج م ل (j-m-l). The source gloss 'Adornment' is broadly consistent. Same name as jamal.
